verdicts.reason: Both make the same mistakes. The quote is pulled out of its frame and pushed against the top-left edge. The illustrated frame is shrunk to a tiny thumbnail in the centre, and a stray 'BEAUTY' text that is unreadable at this size appears inside it. 'CAROLYN MURPHY' sits alone at the far right, cut off from the quote, with large dead gaps between the three pieces, so the original's framed-quote design is lost. The two candidates look the same; any difference in the frame's scale is too small to matter.
